activity.overview: Use a fact sheet to write an opinion piece about the best class pet.
activity.prompt: Read "Two Class Pets: A Fact Sheet." Should Room 12 choose a goldfish or a guinea pig? Write an opinion piece. State your opinion in the first paragraph. Give at least two reasons, and support each one with a fact from the fact sheet. Use linking words such as because, for example, also and in addition. End with a conclusion that restates your opinion.
activity.subject: english-language-arts
activity.title: Which Class Pet Should Room 12 Choose?

readings.body:
Room 12 is choosing a class pet. Here are facts about two choices.

GOLDFISH
- Lives in a tank of water with a filter. A single goldfish needs a tank of at least 20 gallons to stay healthy.
- Eats a small pinch of fish flakes once or twice a day.
- The tank water must be partly changed every week.
- Can live 10 years or more with good care.
- Is quiet and does not need to be held. Students can watch it swim and learn about water and fish.
- Can be left over a weekend with an automatic feeder.

GUINEA PIG
- Lives in a large cage with bedding. Guinea pigs are happiest with a partner, so most experts suggest keeping two.
- Eats hay all day, fresh vegetables every day and a small amount of pellets. Needs vitamin C from food.
- The cage must be cleaned every few days.
- Usually lives 5 to 7 years.
- Likes gentle handling and makes squeaking sounds called wheeks when it is excited.
- Cannot be left alone over a weekend; someone must take it home or visit to feed it.
